title: Row location and the multi-workplace location filter
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. A two-workplace org; a serviced asset and an asset never on a work order; the header location control set to one workplace.
custom_steps:
1. Read a serviced row's location and the location of an asset never on a work order.
  2. Change the header location and confirm the list is not narrowed by it.
  3. Use the location filter and confirm each tile counts only what the filter shows.
  4. List the filters the list offers, and look for a customer or status filter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A row's location is the workplace of its asset's most recent work order; an asset never on a work order has no location and shows none.
  • The list is org-wide and never narrowed by the header location; a multi-workplace org gets a location filter instead, and with it applied each tile counts only what the filter shows.
  • The tiles, the Compliance inspection chip and (multi-workplace) the location filter are the only filters - there is no customer or status filter.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R27: “A row's location is the workplace of its asset's most recent work order, which is the only place an asset has a location. An asset never yet on a work order has no location and shows none”
  • S13-R28: “The list is organization wide per S13-R1 and is never narrowed by the location chosen in the header, which would hide every unit never yet serviced. An organization with more than one workplace gets a location filter instead, using the application's filter component”
  • S13-R29: “With the location filter applied, each tile counts only what that filter shows”
  • S13-R12: “The tiles, the Compliance inspection chip and, for an organization with more than one workplace, the location filter of S13-R28 are the list's filters. There is no customer or status filter”

AUTOMATION: HOLD - not yet build-verified on a Maintenance Reminders QA build (feature ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag)
